issues.summary: Victory and defeat terminal paths were not played to completion during the smoke window.
Galaxy checker retains two non-blocking undeclared native event diagnostics and catalog warnings.
The local unit diagnostic cannot resolve several official SC2 packages, although both tested production paths are available and runtime assertions pass.

The SC2 API observer captures a complete initial in_mission snapshot, but this map does not deliver the registered periodic refresh event; long-window stability is therefore proven by launcher process and ScriptError gates. (RuntimeProbe is deprecated; see docs/deprecated-runtime-probe.md.)
